payload.title: The web console sets its text in Barlow and fetches its faces from Google Fonts, which the production CSP (font-src 'self', as the gateway and the Kubernetes ingress already state) refuses, and caps the page column at 1520px and the sd-stack rhythm at 1920px, so a widened window leaves the page frozen
evidence: web/shared-ui/src/styles/theme.css:187-188 (--font-body-sd Barlow, --font-display-sd Barlow Condensed; suderra.css re-points --font-sans to it inside the console scope)
web/shell/index.html:36-38 (Google Fonts preconnect and stylesheet for Barlow, Barlow Condensed, Geist Mono, Instrument Serif, Inter)
apps/gateway-api/src/middleware/security-headers.middleware.ts:150 (font-src 'self' data:) against infrastructure/nginx/droplet.conf:197 (allows fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com)
web/modules/sensor-module/src/pages/plc/PlcDashboardPage.tsx:301 (mx-auto max-w-7xl wrapper; five more sensor pages the same)
payload.rule_violated: Owner decision 2026-10-26 (Okan): the product text face is Inter everywhere and readable, and page content follows the window (grows when widened, shrinks when narrowed); CSP font-src 'self' is the production policy, so no font may depend on a third-party host.
payload.notes: Closed by the UI-0 PR of the Company umbrella program (feat(web): serve Inter from our own origin).
